import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

app = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="name-filter-check-") as temporary:
    inventory = Path(temporary) / "items.json"
    rows = [{"name": "Straße wrench", "quantity": 0},
            {"name": "Brass washer", "quantity": 3},
            {"name": "STRASSE sign", "quantity": 2}]
    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(rows), encoding="utf-8")
    before = inventory.read_bytes()
    for query, expected in [("strasse", [rows[0], rows[2]]),
                            ("", rows), ("missing", [])]:
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(app), str(inventory),
                              "list", "--name", query],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
        assert run.returncode == 0, run.stderr
        assert json.loads(run.stdout) == expected
    assert inventory.read_bytes() == before
print("Name filter acceptance checks passed.")
files..work/name-filter/spec.md:
# Filter inventory listing by name

Status: accepted

Extend the existing CLI with `python3 src INVENTORY list --name QUERY`.
Match names containing QUERY using Unicode case folding, in stored order.
STRASSE must match Straße. Keep repeated matching rows and zero quantities.
An empty query returns every row, and no match returns []. Without --name,
list keeps its existing behavior. Listing never changes the inventory file.
Existing add and CSV import behavior remains unchanged.

Project checks: python3 checks/check_name_filter.py and python3 checks/check_inventory.py.

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="inventory-contract-") as temporary:
    inventory = Path(temporary) / "stock.json"
    incoming = Path(temporary) / "delivery.csv"
    def call(*args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src", str(inventory), *args],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
    first = call("list")
    assert first.returncode == 0 and json.loads(first.stdout) == []
    assert not inventory.exists(), "Listing missing inventory must not create it"
    assert call("add", "Original", "7").returncode == 0
    incoming.write_text('name,quantity\n"Washer, wide",0\nOriginal,2\n', encoding="utf-8")
    loaded = call("import", str(incoming))
    assert loaded.returncode == 0, loaded.stderr
    expected = [{"name": "Original", "quantity": 7},
                {"name": "Washer, wide", "quantity": 0},
                {"name": "Original", "quantity": 2}]
    listing = call("list")
    assert listing.returncode == 0 and json.loads(listing.stdout) == expected
    before = inventory.read_bytes()
    for invalid in ("name,quantity\nGood,1\nBad,nope\n",
                    "name,quantity\nGood,1\nBad,-1\n",
                    "quantity,name\n3,Bad\n"):
        incoming.write_text(invalid, encoding="utf-8")
        rejected = call("import", str(incoming))
        assert rejected.returncode != 0, "Invalid CSV must fail"
        assert inventory.read_bytes() == before, "Rejected import changed saved data"
    assert call("add", "Negative", "-1").returncode != 0
    assert inventory.read_bytes() == before
print("Private inventory contract passed.")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="filter-contract-") as temporary:
    inventory = Path(temporary) / "parts.json"
    rows = [{"name": "Straße", "quantity": 0},
            {"name": "Other", "quantity": 4},
            {"name": "STRASSE", "quantity": 2},
            {"name": "Straße", "quantity": 1}]
    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(rows), encoding="utf-8")
    before = inventory.read_bytes()
    for query, expected in [("STRASSE", [rows[0], rows[2], rows[3]]),
                            ("rass", [rows[0], rows[2], rows[3]]),
                            ("", rows), ("not present", [])]:
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src", str(inventory),
                              "list", "--name", query],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
        assert run.returncode == 0, run.stderr
        assert json.loads(run.stdout) == expected
        assert inventory.read_bytes() == before, "Filtering must not mutate saved data"
    ordinary = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src", str(inventory), "list"],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3)
    assert ordinary.returncode == 0 and json.loads(ordinary.stdout) == rows
print("Private name filter contract passed.")
